versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the warden-messari-agent skill.
- Enables communication with the Messari Deep Research agent for crypto asset and protocol queries using the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol over JSON-RPC 2.0.
- Supports per-request USDC micropayments via x402 on Base and Solana networks; includes ERC-8004 on-chain identity verification.
- No API key required; payments handled via x402 headers and EIP-3009 signatures (gasless).
- Provides detailed integration guide covering protocol discovery, query formatting, payment flow, and example requests.
- Only text input/output supported; streaming and multi-turn conversations are not available in this version.
